build:
seagull-agent v0.0.0-20261005170543-9a0f54c3b650 go1.26.8 linux/amd64
protocol_version 1
event_schema_version 1
inventory_schema_version 1

rounds.name: first
rounds.changed: the agent takes stock of the host for the first time

services.Name: apt-daily-upgrade.service
services.Description: Daily apt upgrade and clean activities

services.Name: e2scrub_all.service
services.Description: Online ext4 Metadata Check for All Filesystems

services.Name: e2scrub_reap.service
services.Description: Remove Stale Online ext4 Metadata Check Snapshots

services.Name: fstrim.service
services.Description: Discard unused blocks on filesystems from /etc/fstab

services.Name: getty-static.service
services.Description: getty on tty2-tty6 if dbus and logind are not available

services.Name: initrd-cleanup.service
services.Description: Cleaning Up and Shutting Down Daemons

services.Name: initrd-parse-etc.service
services.Description: Mountpoints Configured in the Real Root

services.Name: kmod-static-nodes.service
services.Description: Create List of Static Device Nodes

services.Name: systemd-battery-check.service
services.Description: Check battery level during early boot

services.Name: systemd-bsod.service
services.Description: Displays emergency message in full screen.

services.Name: systemd-fsck-root.service
services.Description: File System Check on Root Device

services.Name: systemd-fsckd.service
services.Description: File System Check Daemon to report status

services.Name: systemd-machine-id-commit.service
services.Description: Commit a transient machine-id on disk

services.Name: systemd-remount-fs.service
services.Description: Remount Root and Kernel File Systems

services.Name: systemd-sysext.service
services.Description: Merge System Extension Images into /usr/ and /opt/

services.Name: systemd-tmpfiles-setup-dev-early.service
services.Description: Create Static Device Nodes in /dev gracefully
